Please fill in your details, add photos of your documents (this fills in the details for you – check them), and sign in the boxes at the bottom by tapping them. Then tap Finish & send PDF and send it to LuxeClub on WhatsApp. Your details stay on your phone until you send the PDF.

Click any text to fill it in – it saves automatically on this computer. Use Read documents to fill details from photos of the customer's passport, Emirates ID, driving licence or trade licence: anything filled in automatically is highlighted yellow – check it against the photo. Customers can sign in the boxes at the bottom with a mouse or finger, or sign the printed copy. Online agreements sends the customer a link: they upload their documents, you add the car and price, then they sign on their phone with the same link (you need to be logged in to the website). Download PDF makes a locked PDF with the terms and conditions as page 2.

Read documents

Choose who the document belongs to, then the document type, and pick a clear photo (flat, in focus, whole document in frame). For a passport use the photo page; for an Emirates ID use the back (with the <<< lines).
